Phase 3 step 1 — Holtburg landblock render

Fetches ../../dats/assets.hba via the §8 step 4 HttpResourceSource, parses eor/cell:0xA9B4FFFF into a CellLandblock, and hands the 9×9 height grid to PixiJS as a 128-triangle mesh. Colour ramps blue→green→brown→white by elevation. Requires the fixture to have been built with dat2hba --profile pruned (the micro profile excludes eor/cell).
